generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final in-game environment concept image for an existing 2D Chinese prison factory game. Generate a polished NEW cafeteria redesign, based on the attached references, NOT a screenshot of an editor.
Reference roles: Image 1 (factory plan crop with red rectangle) supplies cafeteria layout: wide rectangular room, continuous kitchen/serving equipment along NORTH wall, EXACTLY FIVE parallel communal tables arranged left-to-right, each table's long axis NORTH-SOUTH. Image 2 (current bathroom game view) supplies CURRENT GAME camera, small outlined stylized characters, crisp illustrated materials, pale cutaway walls, restrained shadow, orthographic aligned tile grid. Do not copy bathroom fixtures into cafeteria.
Main scene: one whole compact cafeteria viewed from above in the same high-angle orthographic 2D game camera. All wall edges horizontal/vertical, no diagonal isometric diamond, no vanishing points. Wide horizontal footprint ~2.3:1; room occupies most of a landscape canvas, show entire building and a slim surrounding grey-green exterior path. Roof removed for interior view. Four corners must join cleanly, thin walls, no enormous generic stone coping.
Design identity: old institutional factory canteen, warm muted ivory worn plaster above grey-olive tiled wainscot, narrow dull metal corner caps, grey-beige small square anti-slip ceramic floor with subtle wear and clean readable seams. Modest navy-grey metal doors and horizontal industrial frosted windows. Northern wall cream enamel sign text EXACTLY “食堂”. Restrained aged materials, clear edges, no noisy blur or photographic grain, same flat readable game detail as bathroom.
Layout invariants: Along north wall an unbroken practical food service band spanning most of room width, integrated low grey stainless/muted blue-grey cabinets, closed food storage, rice kettle, stove, sinks, dish racks; equipment visibly touches wall and belongs to cafeteria, NOT random industrial machine benches. A shallow serving ledge faces dining area with just TWO open modest rice/boiled cabbage/potato trays and a soup pot, remaining lids closed; all utensils grouped. Include a short staff working slot within north band, a SMALL stylized cook in cream uniform and simple white cap standing near its right end; serving band depth limited so tables and queue are not squeezed. Continuous empty lateral queuing aisle immediately south of counter.
Dining area: EXACTLY FIVE matching narrow rectangular warm worn wood tabletops, LONG AXIS vertical in image, each with two long benches flanking EAST and WEST sides, slim dark steel frames; aligned in one horizontal row left-to-right, not 2x2, no sixth table. Each table has one simple metal meal tray, small enamel cup, nothing lavish. Tabletop top surfaces clearly visible, benches consistent camera, generous gaps each side, south cross-aisle continuously clear. Two small orange prisoner characters illustrate scale, one standing in left aisle and one walking in right aisle, heads naturally readable but whole characters small relative to long tables, same cartoon proportions as reference2; no huge crowd or enlarged chibi foreground.
Support props: west side shallow metal tray cabinet and water urn against wall, east lower corner one compact dirty-dish return trolley and two covered waste buckets against wall, just two small restrained plants by corners if room permits. No clutter in walking lanes. Entrances west upper side linking dorm corridor, north two modest passage gaps linking activity hall, east linking courtyard; south boundary solid toward laundry (no new south main entrance). View openings unobstructed. Doors/walls clean continuous joins with consistent thickness. Subtle functional room sign on wall only.
Light flat daylight soft warm-grey indoor shadow; avoid dramatic beams, glow, orange highlights, film grading. No HUD, editor controls, cursor, red rectangle, explanatory arrows, diagram labels, ornate ornament, modern restaurant seats, polished luxury buffet, neon, excessive dirt, gore, glossy 3D render. Final image should be plausibly implementable as game sprites, attractive but faithful to factory plan, sharp proportional architecture and five-table arrangement. Output a large landscape final concept illustration.

refinement.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Final refinement of the cafeteria concept. Image1 is edit target, preserve all FIVE north-south communal tables, their exact arrangement, benches, utensils, central floor, 2 orange small characters, cook, north service equipment, composition, camera, dimensions and overall illustration style.
Change ONLY architecture finish, south door access, and modest meal coloring:
1. Replace heavy rounded beige stone-block coping on all four walls with a slim flat ivory painted plaster edge and narrow dull dark-steel frame/metal corner trims. No chunky stone blocks or archlike cap, no fat rounded coping. Walls are factory canteen partitions: upper warm off-white slightly worn plaster, lower muted grey-olive ceramic tile, slender charcoal metal borders. The north sign “食堂” remains exact. All four corners connect continuously at same thickness, clean junctions. South wall exterior shows olive tiled lower dado rather than grey masonry blocks. Keep upper industrial windows and existing north/east/west doors in same places.
2. Add TWO modest closed navy-grey service doors to south wall only, matching the existing institutional doors, no obstruction protruding into aisle. One at about 34% of south wall length from left, leading to laundry; the other near 91% from left, leading to equipment room. Keep both doors narrow (one standard door-width), clearly framed, aligned exactly on southern wall edge. Main broad south cross-aisle remains empty. No text labels above these doors, no arrows.
3. The TWO open hot-food bins should be dull boiled cabbage and pale potato pieces rather than rich colorful vegetables or brown meatballs. A plain rice kettle and soup pot, all other bins closed. Table trays similarly small plain rice and dull vegetable portions. No restaurant buffet abundance.
Everything else invariant. Keep high-angle orthographic horizontal/vertical aligned 2D illustrated game camera, sharp low-noise materials, same tiny stylized outlines, flat daylight, same large landscape resolution. No UI or diagram.
